title: Reading History: *-va/-ve* Participles
grammar: Recap: *-va/-ve* clauses in a history text
goal: I can say what someone did first with a *-va/-ve* participle (*A földet felosztva az állam átalakította …*).
I can talk about historical social groups (*dzsentri réteg*, *agrárproletariátus*, *birtokstruktúra*).
I can describe a social change in a history text.
